requirements.text: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
2+ years of professional experience working with backend systems, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, platform engineering, or production services.
Experience building and operating systems where reliability, security, scalability, and performance are critical.
Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, authentication, authorization, IAM, RBAC, and access-control models.
Experience building integrations with enterprise SaaS platforms or other mission-critical business systems.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, production infrastructure, deployments, observability, monitoring, and operational tooling.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across application, service, and infrastructure layers.
Solid software engineering fundamentals and the ability to make thoughtful production architecture decisions.
Proven ability to independently drive technical projects from initial design through deployment and long-term operation.
Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, SOC 2, data protection, or access governance is a plus.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across infrastructure, AI, security, platform, and product engineering teams.
Comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment where technical requirements and priorities evolve quickly.
